text: A fossil hand with webbed fingers draws a party of scientists, including David Reed and his girlfriend Kay, aboard the steamer Rita [down an Amazon tributary|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] to the Black Lagoon, a paradise from which no one has returned. Beneath them swims a living Gill-man, [watching Kay as she swims|wants|a lover to possess]. When the crew start dying and the creature [blocks the lagoon's mouth with fallen logs|rules|trapped with no way out], the boat becomes a cage on [the dark water|images|water and drowning].
